## What the fix does

1. `_PREFIX_RE`: now `^(?:\[[^\]]{1,64}\]\s*)+(?<=\s)` — allows optional whitespace BETWEEN bracket groups (the dup form), but the `(?<=\s)` lookbehind keeps `[A]body` (no separator) from being eaten.
2. `extract_sub_token`: rewritten to walk leading bracket-groups iteratively via a new `_LEADING_BRACKET_RE`. With ≥2 leading brackets, returns the LAST one as the SUB. The trailing-whitespace check mirrors `strip_prefix` so the two helpers agree.
3. `_SUB_TOKEN_RE`: removed (unused after the rewrite).

## Test results

`python3 -m unittest tests.test_session_titles -v` → **119 passed, 0 failed** (was 103 before; +16 new). All existing tests intact.

New tests added to `PrefixTest` (13) + `PlanRenamesTest` (2). They cover: clean chain, dup form, triple dup, space-separated `[A] [B]` edge, `[A][B]nospace` (must NOT strip), bare/empty titles, None title, plus end-to-end self-heal via `plan_renames`.
